tone.target: dry acoustic strum, intimate folk vocal bed
tone.profile: dry acoustic strum, intimate folk vocal bed
tone.summary: Simulates a close-mic, dry acoustic strumming sound using clean preamps and minimal cabinet coloration.

rig.name: Noah Kahan - Stick Season - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean tones.

blocks.purpose: Gentle compression to even out strumming dynamics and add warmth.
blocks.gap: The ideal choice would be a dedicated acoustic preamp/DI sim, but Comp is the best clean option available.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No gain or crunch is desired.
Provides a clean, non-breakup tone suitable for acoustic emulation.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is chosen for its clean headroom and lack of aggressive breakup compared to tube models.

blocks.purpose: Simulates a close-miked, dry acoustic sound source.
blocks.gap: A dedicated DI/acoustic cab would be better, but US 2x12 provides the necessary clean character and size.

blocks.purpose: Slight tonal shaping to enhance the strumming clarity without adding color.
blocks.gap: The goal is flat EQ, but slight boosts are used to ensure the acoustic texture cuts through the mix.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No filtering or sweeping effects needed.
Bypass. Avoid chorus or other movement effects.
Minimal slapback effect to add subtle depth without sounding like a traditional echo.
blocks.gap: The goal is minimal ambience, so the delay settings are kept extremely low and short.

blocks.purpose: Adds the slightest sense of space (intimate folk vocal bed) without sounding wet or cavernous.
blocks.gap: The reverb must be kept extremely subtle to avoid muddying the dry acoustic strum.

improvements.summary: Replace the generic cabinet simulation with a dedicated acoustic/DI IR to achieve a truly dry, close-mic folk sound.

proposals.recommendedAsset: dedicated Acoustic DI Impulse Response (e.g., Neumann U47 or specific acoustic mic IR)
proposals.reason: The current US 2x12 is too colored and electric; a dedicated DI/acoustic IR is needed for dry folk texture.
